questions.enonce_markdown: You were involved in a fight at school and have been suspended by the school Disciplinary Council. Write a letter of apology to your father, who has heard about the incident and is very angry. You may explain the cause of the fight and make a serious commitment never to fight again. Your name is Adrienne and you are a student of GBHS Likundo. *(200 to 250 words)*
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Une lettre d'excuse à un parent suit la disposition d'une lettre personnelle (adresse de l'expéditeur, date, formule d'appel *Dear Dad*, corps en paragraphes, formule finale suivie de la signature) et comporte quatre mouvements : l'excuse sincère, l'explication des faits, la reconnaissance de la faute, puis l'engagement précis de ne pas recommencer ; le ton reste respectueux et sans esprit de justification.

**Ce que le sujet impose.** Il s'agit d'une lettre à un proche, avec un ton respectueux, qui comporte quatre contenus : des excuses, la cause de la bagarre, la reconnaissance de la faute et un engagement ferme de ne pas recommencer. Les données du sujet (Adrienne, GBHS Likundo) vont dans l'en-tête et la signature. Le sujet n'indique ni adresse précise ni date : l'élève peut en inventer une cohérente.

**Lettre modèle.**

Adrienne

GBHS Likundo

15th May 2021

**Dear Dad,**

I am writing to tell you how deeply sorry I am about the fight that led to my suspension from school. I know you have heard about it and that you are angry and disappointed. You have every right to be.

Let me explain what happened. A classmate kept insulting my family in front of everybody. Instead of reporting him to the discipline master, I lost my temper and hit him. I now understand that violence solves nothing and that I should have stayed calm.

I know my behaviour has brought shame on you and disturbed my studies. During my suspension, I will revise my lessons every day so that I do not fall behind, and I will help with the housework without complaining.

I promise you that I will never fight again. If anyone provokes me, I will walk away or report the matter to my teachers. I will also apologise to my classmate and to the Disciplinary Council when I return.

Please forgive me, Dad. You have always made so many sacrifices for my education, and I do not want to disappoint you again. I am ready to accept any punishment you think fair.

**Your loving daughter,**

**Adrienne**

### Piège à éviter
Ne cherche pas à te justifier au point de rejeter la faute sur l'autre élève : une lettre d'excuse qui accuse davantage qu'elle ne s'excuse ne répond pas à la consigne.

### Conseil
Garde un ton respectueux mais naturel (*Dear Dad*, pas *Dear Sir*), et termine par un engagement concret (*I will walk away*) plutôt que par une promesse générale.
